ROB-01 controlled robustness report

Existing held-out cohort; frozen models and temperatures

Negative oriented NLL change means deterioration; positive paired advantage favours the comparator. Positive ECE change means worse calibration. Intervals condition on fixed models and fixed corruption realisations. No refitting. No causal or population-wide robustness claim.

Each curve averages three training seeds and three corruption replicates. Tables retain every seed, replicate and length/class count. The 324 evaluations are dependent, not 324 independent experiments. GBDT seed repetitions may be identical.

Absolute NLL under incomplete observations; means over seeds and corruption replicates

Oriented NLL change from clean; means over seeds and corruption replicates

Calibration deterioration; fixed clean temperatures; means over seeds and corruption replicates

Macro robustness comparisons; descriptive 95% application-cluster intervals; x = seed means

Classwise recall at threshold 0.5; raw/scaled decisions identical

Length diagnostic at highest severity; original groups retained; means over seeds/replicates

Actual corruption; denominators exclude existing missing values / protected events
